steps.name: Home
steps.goal: If Your data and AI providers is visible, tap Agree and continue to enter the local demo. Otherwise only wait for the session list. Do not tap the composer.
steps.done: Home shows a Threads section with the Pricing ideas thread.

steps.name: Thread
steps.goal: Tap the row named Pricing ideas under the Threads heading. Do not tap the message field.
steps.done: The thread is open and its messages are listed.
expect: @omg update the pricing page with the cap

steps.name: Replies
steps.goal: Tap the reply link that says the task needs you. Do not tap the thread title.
expect: Agreed. Ship it after the Stripe question.

steps.name: Image in replies
steps.goal: Do not tap anything. Only wait.
steps.done: The Pricing mockup picture is on screen.

steps.name: Context menu
steps.goal: Press and hold the picture (the element labelled Pricing mockup. Open). Do not tap anything else.
steps.done: The native iOS context menu is open over the picture and offers Save or Share.

steps.name: Share sheet
steps.goal: Tap Save or Share in the context menu.
steps.done: The iOS share sheet is open and offers Save Image.
